mapper.select: SELECT LSTG_ID, LSTG_ADD FROM LISTING WHERE LSTG_LAT IS NULL OR LSTG_LNG IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE LISTING SET LSTG_LAT = #{lstgLat}, LSTG_LNG = #{lstgLng} WHERE LSTG_ID = #{lstgId}
mapper.select: SELECT LSTG_ID, MBR_CD, LSTG_TYPE_CODE2, LSTG_ADD, LSTG_ADD2, LSTG_NM, LSTG_TYPE_CODE1, RENTAL_PTY_ID FROM LISTING WHERE LSTG_TYPE_CODE1 = #{lstgTypeCode1}

SELECT LSTG_ID, MBR_CD, LSTG_TYPE_CODE2, LSTG_ADD, LSTG_ADD2, LSTG_EX_AREA, LSTG_GR_AREA, LSTG_ROOM_CNT, LSTG_ROOM_NUM, LSTG_DST, LSTG_TYPE_SALE, LSTG_LEASE, LSTG_LEASE_M, LSTG_LEASE_AMT, LSTG_FLOOR, LSTG_PARK_YN, LSTG_REG_DATE, LSTG_NM, LSTG_TYPE_CODE1, RENTAL_PTY_ID, LSTG_POSTAL FROM LISTING WHERE LSTG_ID = #{lstgId} AND LSTG_DEL ='N'
